name: antiforensics_residency
description: An intruder who cleans up after themselves and lives without a file on disk. These are the classes where the endpoint's own account of itself stops being trustworthy, so the assertions are about capturing raw evidence rather than a tool's summary of it.

expect.id: a deleted-but-running binary is visible in the process table
a deleted-but-running binary is FLAGGED as a finding
raw wtmp is captured, not just `last` output
raw btmp is captured, not just `lastb` output
a truncated wtmp is FLAGGED as a log wipe
an unlinked payload held open is FLAGGED
and its CONTENTS are recovered — the descriptor was the only copy
the recovered bytes are hashed for custody
